title: HeavyTailedPL.lean

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Nonconvex objectives satisfying the global PL inequality are permitted; convexity and strong convexity are not required.

problem_class.label: pl
problem_class.details: Globally differentiable, bounded-below objective with L-Lipschitz gradient and 2μ(f(x)−inf f)≤‖∇f(x)‖² everywhere; 0<μ≤L and f(x₀)−inf f≤Δ, with Δ≥0.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each query x returns g(x,ξ) using a fresh IID seed. The oracle is jointly measurable, integrable, and unbiased: E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x). One returned gradient counts as one oracle call.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedPL.lean: spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and _run.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform central q-th moment bound E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖^q≤ν^q, with q>2 and ν>0, separately from the variance bound. Polynomial-tail distributions are allowed; exponential moments are not required.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform central second-moment bound E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖²≤σ² for every x, with σ>0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is a second-countable real Hilbert space with its Borel measurable structure; finite dimension is not required. Only E,L,μ,x₀ are public. Noise parameters σ,ν,q, initialization bound Δ, accuracy ε, and confidence δ are hidden. Allowed algorithms use a fixed positive step-size schedule and return the last SGD iterate; the schedule can depend only on public input.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedPL.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, and spec.allowedAlgorithm; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence; LongTails/Algorithms/ScheduledSgd.lean: method.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: A measurable output must satisfy f(output)−inf f≤ε, with ε>0. Under the allowed algorithm restriction, the output is the last iterate after execution with the supplied fixed oracle budget.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedPL.lean: spec.successful and spec.allowedAlgorithm; LongTails/Algorithms/ScheduledSgd.lean: method.output; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence and execute.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P(f(output)−inf f>ε)≤δ, where 0<δ<1. Probability is taken over the algorithm and oracle seeds.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedPL.lean: spec.valid and spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Smooth PL optimization with finite-moment stochastic gradients is established, but this setup adds a specialized information restriction: a positive SGD schedule using only public L,μ,x₀ must provide high-probability last-iterate accuracy while noise, initialization, accuracy, and confidence parameters remain hidden.

descriptionHtml:
Heavy-Tailed SGD under the PL Condition

We consider minimizing a differentiable, possibly nonconvex function f:E→R on a separable real Hilbert space E. Its gradient is L-Lipschitz, and it satisfies the Polyak–Łojasiewicz condition with constant μ, where 0<μ≤L. Write f⋆=infx∈Ef(x)>−∞. A given starting point x0∈E satisfies f(x0)−f⋆≤Δ, where Δ≥0. The oracle returns unbiased stochastic gradients from independent, identically distributed samples, with uniformly bounded second and qth noise moments for q>2, allowing heavy tails. For ε>0 and δ∈(0,1), scheduled SGD must return a measurable last iterate x¯ satisfying P(f(x¯)−f⋆>ε)≤δ, where P is the sample law.

The optimization problem is infx∈Ef(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E. The algorithm receives only E, L, μ, and x0; the noise parameters σ,ν>0, moment order q, initial gap bound Δ, tolerance ε, and failure probability δ may enter the oracle-call budget but not the step-size schedule.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Smoothness). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere on E, with ∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥,x,y∈E.

Assumption 2 (Polyak–Łojasiewicz condition and initialization). The function f is bounded below, and 2μ(f(x)−f⋆)≤∥∇f(x)∥2,x∈E,f(x0)−f⋆≤Δ.

Assumption 3 (Independent sampling and noise moments). Let Ω be a measurable space and P0 a probability measure on Ω. The measurable sample variables (ξt)t≥0 are mutually independent under P, each with distribution P0. The oracle is a jointly measurable map g:E×Ω→E and returns g(x,ξt) at the tth query x∈E. For every fixed x∈E, the map g(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable, and the scalar maps ∥g(x,⋅)−∇f(x)∥2 and ∥g(x,⋅)−∇f(x)∥q are integrable under P0. They satisfy Eξ∼P0[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x),Eξ∼P0[∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥2]≤σ2,Eξ∼P0[∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥q]≤νq.

Our result is algorithm-specific: we analyze scheduled stochastic gradient descent (SGD). Starting from the given x0, the method uses a deterministic schedule (ηt)t≥0 with ηt>0 and performs xt+1=xt−ηtg(xt,ξt),t=0,1,2,…. The schedule depends only on the algorithm inputs specified above. After K∈{0,1,2,…} oracle calls, the output is the last iterate x¯=xK. It must be measurable and satisfy P(f(x¯)−f⋆>ε)≤δ.

comparisonHtml:
A differentiable, bounded-below f on a separable real Hilbert space with its Borel structure has globally L-Lipschitz gradient and satisfies 2μ(f(x)−inff)≤∥∇f(x)∥2, 0<μ≤L, and f(x0)−inff≤Δ. The jointly measurable oracle is unbiased, with uniformly bounded central moments E∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥2≤σ2 and E∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥q≤νq, where σ,ν>0 and q>2; samples are IID. The setup restricts algorithms to plain SGD with positive deterministic steps and last-iterate output. Target: P{f(xT)−inff>ε}≤δ, for ε>0, 0<δ<1. Costs count individual stochastic-gradient calls.

import LongTails.Template
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex

namespace OracleTemplate.ScheduledSgd

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

noncomputable def method (η : ℕ → ℝ) (x0 : E) : Algorithm E E E where
  State := ℕ × E
  initial _ := (0, x0)
  query s := (0, s.2)
  update s g := (s.1 + 1, s.2 - η s.1 • g)
  output s := s.2

end OracleTemplate.ScheduledSgd

open MeasureTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.HeavyTailedPL

open OracleTemplate

structure Public where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [innerE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  [countableE : SecondCountableTopology E]
  L : ℝ
  μ : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Public.normedE Public.innerE Public.completeE Public.measurableE
  Public.borelE Public.countableE

structure Params extends Public where
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  σ : ℝ
  ν : ℝ
  q : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  δ : ℝ

attribute [instance] Params.measurableΩ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Public
  Instance p := p.E → ℝ
  Query p := p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p.toPublic
  valid p := 0 < p.μ ∧ p.μ ≤ p.L ∧ 0 < p.σ ∧ 0 < p.ν ∧ 2 < p.q ∧ 0 ≤ p.Δ ∧
    0 < p.ε ∧ 0 < p.δ ∧ p.δ < 1
  admissible p f O :=
    ∃ (g : p.E → p.Ω → p.E) (P0 : ProbabilityMeasure p.Ω)
      (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → p.Ω)),
    LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (ξ : ℕ → p.Ω) => ξ k) (P0 : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    O = { Seed := fun _ => p.Ω
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (_, x) seed => g x seed } ∧
    (∀ x, HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ p.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    BddBelow (Set.range f) ∧
    (∀ x, 2 * p.μ * (f x - ⨅ y, f y) ≤ ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2) ∧
    f p.x0 - (⨅ y, f y) ≤ p.Δ ∧
    Measurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
    (∀ x, Integrable (g x) (P0 : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x, ∫ ω, g x ω ∂(P0 : Measure _) = gradient f x) ∧
    (∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - gradient f x‖ ^ 2) (P0 : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x, ∫ ω, ‖g x ω - gradient f x‖ ^ 2 ∂(P0 : Measure _) ≤ p.σ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - gradient f x‖ ^ p.q) (P0 : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x, ∫ ω, ‖g x ω - gradient f x‖ ^ p.q ∂(P0 : Measure _) ≤ p.ν ^ p.q)
  successful p f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
      (P : Measure _) {ω | p.ε < f (output ω) - ⨅ y, f y} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p.δ
  allowedAlgorithm p A := ∃ η : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ t, 0 < η t) ∧ A = ScheduledSgd.method η p.x0

end LongTails.Setups.HeavyTailedPL
